name: ErrorSummary
label: Error summary
description: Every error on a form at the top of it, each a link that moves focus to its field.

props.name: errors
props.description: The errors, in the form's order: each the id of the control it belongs to and what is wrong. The summary renders nothing while the list is empty.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, in place of the one `titleLabel` writes. Note: this replaces the native `title` attribute, which ErrorSummary does not expose.

props.name: titleLabel
props.description: The heading for a given number of errors: the count as a number (for a plural rule) and as written in the locale (for display). Defaults to "There is a problem" for one and "There are <count> problems" for more.
props.defaultExpression:
(count: number, formatted: string) =>
  count === 1 ? 'There is a problem' : `There are ${formatted} problems`

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the heading, before the list.

props.name: focusOnMount
props.description: Move focus to the summary when the list goes from empty to holding errors (on a submit), so a screen reader reads it and a keyboard user starts from it. Defaults to true.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading's level, so the summary takes its place in the page's outline. Defaults to 2.

props.name: onErrorClick
props.description: Called with a control's id after its link moves focus to it.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the count is written in. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.
